exposure.relief: You thaw out by the fire, painfully.

cs_trailhead.name: The Spine Trailhead
cs_trailhead.description: Where the goat track gives out and the real mountain begins. Prayer flags snap in the wind.

cs_hut.name: Bergen's Hut
cs_hut.description: A stone hut with a fire that's never let die. Ropes, ice-axes, and frostbitten maps.

cs_icefall.name: The Icefall
cs_icefall.description: A frozen river of ice, cracked into blue crevasses. Fixed ropes, some cut.

trap.name: a hidden crevasse
trap.hit: The snow gives way, and you drop into a crevasse before your rope catches.
trap.avoid: You probe the snow, and step round a crevasse.

sign.name: flags
sign.text: A prayer flag marks where the last climber went into a crevasse on the icefall. The snow hides the rest.

cs_seracs.name: The Serac Field
cs_seracs.description: Towers of ice leaning over the path. One fell last night.

trap.name: a falling serac
trap.hit: A tower of ice comes down, and you're under it.
trap.avoid: You hear the crack and throw yourself clear.

sign.name: seracs
sign.text: The seracs ahead lean further every day. Go fast and don't stop under them.

cs_ridge.name: The Long Ridge
cs_ridge.description: A ridge of rock and snow with a drop on both sides. The wind never stops.

cs_cairn_east.name: The East Cairn
cs_cairn_east.description: A signal cairn, built for a fire and never lit.

features.cairn: Dry wood packed inside, waiting for a flame.

cs_knife.name: The Knife-Edge
cs_knife.description: The ridge narrows to a blade of snow. Something huge and white lies across it, asleep.

cs_cave_mouth.name: Frostfang Caves
cs_cave_mouth.description: A cave mouth fanged with icicles. Out of the wind, at least.

cs_cave_fire.name: The Ice Cave
cs_cave_fire.description: A cave with an old fire-pit and a stack of wood. Someone sheltered here.

features.pit: Light it and it'll keep you alive.

cs_cave_deep.name: The Deep Ice
cs_cave_deep.description: Blue ice, deep under the mountain. A climber sits against the wall, frozen.

features.climber: Frozen sitting up, a journal in her lap.

cs_saddle.name: The Saddle
cs_saddle.description: A saddle of snow between two peaks. A second cairn, and a dead man's pack.

features.beacon: The summit beacon: a cairn as tall as you, packed with wood.
features.pack: A frozen pack. A journal sticks out.

cs_summit.name: The Summit
cs_summit.description: The top of the Spine. The sky is huge, and in a high wind it tears open: you can see islands in the clouds through the rip.

features.rip: A tear in the sky. In a strong wind it widens enough to step through.

journal_1.name: frozen journal
journal_1.description: A frozen journal. The last entry: "Day 4. The seracs nearly had Orri. Halvard says the summit, in a gale. Why a gale?"

journal_2.name: frozen journal
journal_2.description: A frozen journal. The last entry: "Day 9. Fire's out. Halvard went up alone. He said the sky opens."

journal_3.name: frozen journal
journal_3.description: A frozen journal. The last entry: "Day 11. I see it. Islands in the clouds. Halvard's gone through. I'm too cold to follow."

flint.name: Bergen's flint
flint.description: Flint, steel and dry tinder in an oilskin.

bergen.name: Bergen
bergen.label: Mountaineer
bergen.description: a weathered climber with three fingers on one hand
bergen.details: A weathered climber with three fingers on one hand.

topics.work: Ask me about the mountain, the expedition, or the cairns.

mountain.text: Up there, the cold kills you a step at a time. You'll want a Fur Cloak. Ask me for the cloak.

topics.cloak: Keep it on. Fires are in my hut and in the Ice Cave. Nowhere else.

expedition.text: Three of Halvard's expedition went up last winter and never came down. They kept journals. One on the serac field, one in the deep ice, one on the saddle. Find out what they found.

cairns.text: Two signal cairns, the East Cairn on the ridge and the beacon on the Saddle. Light them and the next lot can find their way. Take my flint.

topics.gyre: Halvard swore he saw islands in the sky from the summit, in a gale. He was always swearing something.

lure.sense: {Where}, a thread of smoke from a fire that never goes out.
lure.rumour: Bergen up on the Spine is looking for climbers.

hulda.name: Hulda
hulda.label: Hunter
hulda.description: a huge woman in white furs, with a spear
hulda.details: A huge woman in white furs, with a spear.

hunger.text: The White Hunger sleeps on the Knife-Edge. Big as a house. Nothing I have has scratched it. You want to cross the ridge, you creep past it. You want to kill it, you're mad, and I'll pay.

lure.sense: {Where}, prayer flags snapping in the wind.
lure.rumour: Hulda at the trailhead is hunting something big.

ice_troll_1.name: Ice Troll
ice_troll_1.label: Troll
ice_troll_1.description: a blue-grey troll with icicles in its beard
ice_troll_1.details: A blue-grey troll with icicles in its beard.

frost_wyrmling_1.label: Wyrm
frost_wyrmling_1.description: a young white wyrm, all teeth and frost

white_hunger.name: the White Hunger
white_hunger.label: Great Beast
white_hunger.description: a white beast the size of a house, asleep across the ridge
white_hunger.details: A white beast the size of a house, asleep across the ridge.

attacks.name: crush
attacks.hit: {actor} rears up and comes down on {target}!

spine_pick.name: Spine Pick
spine_pick.description: Halvard's ice-pick. In the cold it bites deep.

fur_cloak.name: Fur Cloak
fur_cloak.description: A heavy cloak of white fox. On the Spine, it's the difference between cold and dead. Keeps off the cold.

climbers_boots.name: Climber's Boots
climbers_boots.description: Nailed boots and wool puttees. +1 Vigor.

hunger_pelt.name: White Hunger Pelt
hunger_pelt.description: The pelt of the White Hunger. Nothing cold gets through it. +2 Vigor.

cloak.goal: Ask Bergen for it: DISCUSS CLOAK WITH BERGEN.

effects.text: Bergen throws you a Fur Cloak. "Wear it. WEAR CLOAK. Above the trailhead the cold counts every step."

journals.goal: Find the three frozen journals: on the serac field, in the deep ice under the Frostfang Caves, and on the Saddle.

back.goal: Bring them to Bergen: DISCUSS EXPEDITION WITH BERGEN.

effects.text: Bergen reads them by the fire, slowly. "Through the sky. The fool. Here: Halvard's pick. He won't need it."

flint.goal: Take Bergen's flint: DISCUSS FLINT WITH BERGEN.

east.goal: Light the East Cairn, on the Long Ridge: USE FLINT ON CAIRN.

effects.text: The cairn catches, and roars. Its light will be seen from the trailhead.

beacon.goal: Now the beacon on the Saddle, past the Knife-Edge: USE FLINT ON BEACON.

effects.text: The beacon goes up like a torch. The whole mountain sees it.

back.goal: Tell Bergen: DISCUSS CAIRNS WITH BERGEN.

kill.goal: Kill the White Hunger, on the Knife-Edge. Its crush can be blocked. Probably.

back.goal: Tell Hulda: DISCUSS HUNGER WITH HULDA.

effects.text: Hulda stares, then laughs until she cries. "Take the pelt. You earned it twice."
